cheats: Cheats only unlock after the story, and most guides say using one disables trophies and saving. GTASpotter notes whether they block trophies is not yet known. Keep them off your trophy save either way.
hours_total: ~200 hours (Push Square says 300+; see the dispute on Vice Got a Price!)
missable_summary: One trophy can be missed (Positive Mental Attitude, Chapter 1 meditation), one strand is time-sensitive (Yago's race), and five stranger chains carry a single-source warning. Everything else stays open after the story.
note: Stage trophy lists are not stored here: the app derives them from each trophy's stage field in trophies.json, so the roadmap can never drift from the data.
saves: 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves), then rotate the rest. Keep one untouched save from just before the final mission.

stages.blurb: Play the five chapters and enjoy the story. Do optional missions as they appear, scan vehicles and study animals on the way, and above all do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends.
tips: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is the only missable moment in the game.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter; there is no mission replay.
Scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study new animals with binoculars as you go: 200 vehicles and 100 animals are needed later.
Beat Cal at fishing and finish an arcade game while they are in front of you.
stages.title: Story — five chapters

stages.blurb: After the credits, the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats. Work through it: it is the longest stretch of the platinum, but the thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion by PowerPyx's reckoning.
tips: Clear the categories that need everything first: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races, all 15 Target Decks.
Do not stop at trophy numbers: 300 stunts (not 250), 70 challenges (not 50), 30 races won (not 20).
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each and feed Dime on the Dollar at the same time.
stages.title: 100% Completion checklist

stages.blurb: Stranger strands are not part of 100%, so finish them now, along with the character questlines, the partner trophies and the one-off feats. Most of the miscellaneous trophies pop along the way.
tips: Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment it appears — it carries an hourglass icon and may expire.
Finish the five character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and Bret's hunting chain.
Buy the 8 garages, register 10 vehicles, and spend your way to $100,000 across the shops.
Save the unconfirmed trophy (Bad Luck, I Guess) for last — no method is confirmed yet.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup

stages.blurb: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is nothing else to do for it.
tips: Check the tracker for anything left: the progress meter shows exactly what is missing.
Claim nothing here — the trophy is automatic.
stages.title: Platinum
